timeline.body: Cloudflare is aware of and investigating an issue with Cloudflare Worker Builds which potentially impacts multiple customers. Further detail will be provided as more information becomes available. Existing Workers and Containers are unaffected.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
